decision.title: Patterns: front end, match expressions, priorities (packet )

item.p: Pattern AST: 19 kinds appended to sxml_ast_kind, one per ..._pattern node type of grammars/xslt_pattern (root PATTERN), the field PATTERN and the flag OPEN (map pattern *); everything inside predicates, node tests, names and constants stays the XPath kinds. Built by sxml_xslt_pattern_build_ast (declared in xpath_ast_internal.h beside the other front ends) through the parser part seam. Every syntax error is XTSE0340 (6.3.1), as is an outermost function call not binding to fn:doc#1, id#1-2, element-with-id#1-2, key#2-3, root#0 (prefixed names checked when the match expression is built). 4.4 made these additive edits to src/xpath_ast_internal.h, tests/xpath_parse_test.c (names) and the sxml link line of the root CMakeLists.txt (sxml_grammar_xslt_pattern), as foresaw.

Match expression: a pattern becomes an XPath AST (root XPATH) of xs:boolean over the item as context value, built by one loop over an explicit task list () and lowered like any XPath expression through the embedding entry (); no new IR kind. Copied subtrees keep their source spans (the output AST starts with a copy of the pattern's text store). Private variables are in namespace urn:x-sxml:pattern-variable. XNode patterns are read right to left (6.3.2.3): a step is a self test on the item, the steps to its left a condition on its parent ("/") or an ancestor ("//"); a step with predicates is selected again from its origin so positions count as in the formal definition; leading steps use child-or-top, attribute-or-top, namespace-or-top. Patterns with intersect/except, a filter on a parenthesized pattern or an RHS parenthesized pattern beyond steps and unions use the formal definition (some ancestor-or-self candidate $x with the item in $x/(EE)). Simple, atomic, map, record, array and JNode patterns test the item directly (6.3.3-6.3.9; sequence patterns: count, then every item).

Errors in patterns (6.5): a match expression may raise; every evaluator of one (APPLY_TEMPLATES 4.8, xsl:number 4.11, grouping 4.9, keys 4.10) treats a dynamic or type error as "no match". current() in patterns is the item being matched; 4.10 must provide it (the match expression keeps current() as written).

Match function: sxml_xslt_pattern_lower_match_function adds a top-level IR function (item()) as xs:boolean whose fixed focus is its parameter, for template rules (callers outside a lowering machine, no locals in scope); inline uses lower the match expression themselves.

Default priority: sxml_xslt_pattern_compute_default_priority (6.4, incl. the 4.0 union minimum, element/attribute table, atomic 0.5 - 2^-N by derivation depth, map, record, array, JNode rules, ##any through a flag).

Suite: of 19,441 pattern attributes in xslt40-test, 19,288 parse; all of them build a match expression; 18,916 lower with only the stylesheet's namespaces, 372 need what a stylesheet adds (XSLT functions current/key/id/accumulators, 145; schema or user types, 227).
Rejected: evaluating root(.)//(EE) for every pattern (quadratic per match); a lowering part over pattern kinds (would need the core's node test resolution, which is private to xpath_lower.c).
